english.meaning: go to the front; lead off
english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for being in charge of people or leading a group or procession.
Use this when leading people or a group, rather than simply showing someone a route.

examples.english: I head the volunteer team into the venue.
examples.traditional: 我帶領義工隊行入會場。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 daai3 ling5 ji6 gung1 deoi6 haang4 jap6 wui6 coeng4

examples.english: The captain works to guide the whole team through the project.
examples.traditional: 隊長帶領成隊人完成個計劃。
